comment: Provenance for third-party scripts that BrainBox used to fetch from a CDN at
runtime and now ships locally (T002 F2). Run `npm run verify-vendor` to check that
every file still matches the bytes that were downloaded; `npm run verify-vendor -- --refetch`
also checks that each URL still serves them. Same assets, versions, URLs and checksums
In public/vendor/, not public/lib/: public/lib/ is gitignored and holds the built bundles.
Loaded by view/atlasmaker/src/atlasmaker.js (the script console, not in the embed).

assets.name: codeflask
assets.note: Was requested unpinned as unpkg.com/codeflask/build/codeflask.min.js. 1.4.1 is the version microdraw vendored from that URL (2026-08-05).

assets.note: Was 0.1.1. 0.2.1's init(el, styleParent) takes the element, not a selector (it calls el.querySelector), so atlasmaker.js passes document.getElementById('logScript').
